title: Juniper and the Wolf
author: Jonah Vasquez
blurb: Paloma Villalobos, a thief who steals memories, has spent five years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. But when a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must reforge a broken covenant between realms before the moon completes its thirteenth turn.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
